title: MIT team discovers that unrealistic training data makes AI climate predictions more reliable
headline: MIT team discovers that unrealistic training data makes AI climate predictions more reliable
ai_overview: MIT researchers have developed a method that lets AI climate models get by with a single training run instead of the usual six to eight. An algorithm generates deliberately unrealistic scenarios with extreme CO2 or methane swings that make the model more robust.
